title.ko: 14세 미만 아동의 개인정보 처리에 관한 사항

rules.statement: State the personal data processed to obtain the legal guardian's consent (e.g. guardian name, mobile number).
Separately state that guardian consent is obtained and how it is verified, describing the procedure actually used rather than restating the law.
Use an easy-to-understand format and clear, plain language for this section.
If the main users are children under 14, provide a separate children's version of the policy (Appendix 2).

rules.element: guardian data collected from the child
rules.statement: Guardian data collected directly from the child without guardian consent may be listed under S03.

goodPatterns: Clause 1: consent for a child's data is obtained from the legal guardian.
Clause 2: minimal guardian data is requested from the child; the guardian marks consent on a web page and the confirmation is sent to the guardian by text message (describe the method really used).

commonDefects.defect: Copies the statutory list of verification methods instead of the method actually used.
Service admits under-14 users but the section is missing or says children are not processed.
Minimum age in terms (T06) conflicts with this section (cross-doc).

warnNote: Handling = warn: drafter emits a manual-review placeholder plus the guideline-backed elements; legal review confirms the verification method.

needsVerification.note: Statutory list of acceptable guardian-verification methods is not in the guideline; do not generate it.
